channel.description: Latest articles from The Grand Island Independent (theindependent.com)

item.title: 5 yards: The Turner Turnaround
item.description: Sure enough, with six seconds left Jamal Turner caught the first touchdown of his career, the finisher to an 80-yard drive that included a fourth-and-10 conversion.

item.title: 15 yards: Skating to Miami
item.description: Ice, oranges and a whole lot of drama. Add it all up, it was one of the more entertaining Huskers-Sooners clashes in the rivalry's history. Thanks to a 15-yard run from Calvin Jones, it was also a Nebraska win.

item.title: 9 yards: Mo's redemption
item.description: With the game on the line in College Station, Texas, Maurice Purify was the target. And despite a miserable day plagued by drops, the 6-foot-4 Purify, facing a smaller defender, was a good target to have.

item.title: 4-year-old with Morquio Syndrome may be only child in Nebraska with the condition
item.description: As far as her parents know, Reina is the only child in Nebraska with the condition, but the family was able to connect with another young patient in Colorado.

item.title: The Real Night of the Twisters: 6-episode audio podcast (2021)
item.description: On the evening of June 3, 1980, Grand Island was hit by a storm unlike any seen before. The Independent presents a 6-episode podcast series covering the events and aftermath of that terrible night.

item.title: Former Fremont superintendent remembered for leadership, commitment to students
item.description: Stephen Sexton, who served as Fremont Public Schools superintendent from 1997 to 2014, died Sunday at age 84. He is remembered for the many ways his leadership grew the district.
